title: 2.10 These and Those
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Point to several things near and far with these and those, contrast them with this and that, and choose between two things with Which one? The red one.
grammar_function: These/those + are + plural noun, beside this/that + is + a + noun; Which one? The + color + one.
prerequisite: 1.3 they are; 2.3 book, phone, bag; 2.5 this/that; 2.8 colors.
speaking_outcome: Say these or those for things near or far, and answer Which one? with a color.
